South Carolina ranks 117th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 91.3% of trips. Sellers led South Carolina with 301 yards on 19-of-24 passing (79.2%) for three touchdowns and two interceptions. He also carried the ball 13 times for 96 yards and two rushing touchdowns. Jabree Coleman carried the ball 13 times for 62 yards, adding two receptions for eight yards. Bennett had four receptions for 107 yards and one touchdown. Texas A&M fell to Alabama 31-20 on Oct. 24. Reed led Texas A&M with 163 yards on 14-of-21 passing (66.7%) for one touchdown and two interceptions. He also carried the ball 17 times for 23 yards and one rushing touchdown.
